code: addresses <- dplyr::tibble(   address_id = c("address_1", "address_2", "address_3"),   address = c(     "Pre-geocoded address in Baltimore County, MD",     "Pre-geocoded address in Baltimore County, MD",     "Pre-geocoded address in Baltimore City, MD"   ),   geoid = c("240054519002", "240054026041", "245102303002") )  addresses #> # A tibble: 3 × 3 #>   address_id address                                      geoid        #>   <chr>      <chr>                                        <chr>        #> 1 address_1  Pre-geocoded address in Baltimore County, MD 240054519002 #> 2 address_2  Pre-geocoded address in Baltimore County, MD 240054026041 #> 3 address_3  Pre-geocoded address in Baltimore City, MD   245102303002 acti_fips12(state = 24, county = 510, tract = 60400, block = 2002) #> [1] "245100604002"

title: Find EPA walkability values for pre-geocoded addresses
text: Pass unique GEOIDs acti_epa_walkability(). geometry = FALSE (default) index attributes downloaded, tibble; use geometry = TRUE (requires ‘sf’) also get block-group polygons. call uses live EPA ArcGIS service, left unevaluated vignette built. returned data include GEOID10, NatWalkInd, , index available, cat_walk_index. cat_walk_index four-level categorization created EPA national walkability index breaks. EPA service may also return layer attributes.
code: walkability <- acti_epa_walkability(   unique(addresses$geoid),   geometry = FALSE )  walkability

title: Find EPA walkability values for pre-geocoded addresses
text: Join two character GEOID fields. Keeping address rows retains multiple addresses within block group.
code: address_walkability <- dplyr::left_join(   addresses,   walkability,   by = c("geoid" = "GEOID10") )  dplyr::select(   address_walkability,   address_id, address, geoid, NatWalkInd, cat_walk_index )

what: Geocoding is a separate step and Census vintage matters
title: Find EPA walkability values for pre-geocoded addresses
text: package deliberately consumes GEOIDs rather geocoding street addresses. Prepare quality-check address--GEOID crosswalk upstream, use workflow . projects need Census-geocoder client, censusxy one option: calls U.S. Census Bureau Geocoding Tools designed batch unique addresses. repository notes longer active development early 2025, check current status validate matches using production workflow. censusxy return columns named GEOID10 GEOID20. return = "geographies", returns Census geography components cxy_state_id, cxy_county_id, cxy_tract_id, cxy_block_id; vintage argument determines Census geography vintage. block-group GEOID can constructed components acti_fips12(). run following code part package’s workflow: illustration possible upstream geocoding step requires censusxy. , 10 20 suffixes mean Census boundary vintage, GEOID length: 2010 2020 block-group identifier contain 12 digits. EPA Walkability Index layer based Census 2010 block groups, package intentionally queries joins non-null, 12-character GEOID10 field. layer also exposes nullable GEOID20 field, alias describes “Census block group 12-digit FIPS code (2018)” declared length 50. contradictory labels establish reliable Census 2020 key. Consequently, GEOID20 used package. Census Geocoder currently offers Census2010_Current geography vintage current benchmark; otherwise, 2020-vintage result converted appropriate Census crosswalk joined EPA release. Never treat similarly shaped 12-digit identifiers different vintages interchangeable. approaches include calling Census Geocoder API directly, using local commercial geocoder, obtaining GEOIDs trusted data provider. Regardless method, confirm result 12-character Census 2010 block-group GEOID passing acti_epa_walkability().
code: geocoded <- censusxy::cxy_geocode(   address_data,   street = "street",   city = "city",   state = "state",   zip = "zip",   return = "geographies",   vintage = "Census2010_Current" )  geocoded$geoid <- acti_fips12(   geocoded$cxy_state_id,   geocoded$cxy_county_id,   geocoded$cxy_tract_id,   geocoded$cxy_block_id )

what: Requesting other EPA attributes or a study area
title: Find EPA walkability values for pre-geocoded addresses
text: EPA service exposes overall NatWalkInd score. particular interest four inputs used create : D2A_EPHHM (employment household density), D2B_E8MIXA (employment household mix), D3b (street-intersection density), D4a (distance nearest transit stop). matching *_Ranked fields provide national ranks. Population, household, worker, land-area, metropolitan-area fields also useful describing screening returned block groups. acti_epa_walkability() queries EPA ArcGIS REST service directly. Use fields limit attributes downloaded, n_max cap number records, filter_geom (‘sf’, sfc, bbox object) predicate select block groups intersect study-area geometry. named arguments passed service ArcGIS query parameters. call acti_epa_walkability(NULL) without spatial filter: requests entire national layer.
code: study_area_walkability <- acti_epa_walkability(   geoid = NULL,   geometry = FALSE,   filter_geom = study_area,   predicate = "intersects",   fields = c("GEOID10", "NatWalkInd", "D2A_EPHHM", "D2B_E8MIXA", "D3b", "D4a") )

title: Access the EPA Walkability Index
text: EPA index reported Census block groups. Start address lookup contains 12-character, Census 2010 block-group GEOIDs; keep identifiers character values leading zeroes retained. state, county, tract, block identifiers available instead, create block-group GEOID acti_fips12(): Query EPA layer unique GEOIDs. live service request; chunk cached subsequent README renders reuse saved result. Join returned index values back address lookup:
code: library(actiwalkability)  addresses <- dplyr::tibble(   address_id = c("address_1", "address_2", "address_3"),   geoid = c("240054519002", "240054026041", "245102303002") )  knitr::kable(addresses) acti_fips12(state = 24, county = 510, tract = 60400, block = 2002) #> [1] "245100604002" walkability <- acti_epa_walkability(   unique(addresses$geoid),   geometry = FALSE,   fields = c("GEOID10", "NatWalkInd") ) knitr::kable(dplyr::select(   as.data.frame(walkability),   GEOID10, NatWalkInd, cat_walk_index )) address_walkability <- dplyr::left_join(   addresses,   walkability,   by = c("geoid" = "GEOID10") )  knitr::kable(dplyr::select(   address_walkability,   address_id, geoid, NatWalkInd, cat_walk_index ))

title: Access the EPA Walkability Index
text: geometry = TRUE also returns EPA block-group polygons (sf object, requires ‘sf’ package), index can mapped directly. hard-coded plot extent provides wider Baltimore, Maryland context. query cached README.
code: walkability_map <- acti_epa_walkability(   unique(addresses$geoid),   geometry = TRUE,   fields = c("GEOID10", "NatWalkInd") )  label_points <- sf::st_coordinates(   sf::st_transform(sf::st_point_on_surface(walkability_map), 4326) ) #> Warning: st_point_on_surface assumes attributes are constant over geometries walkability_labels <- dplyr::mutate(   sf::st_drop_geometry(walkability_map),   longitude = label_points[, "X"],   latitude = label_points[, "Y"] )  ggplot2::ggplot() +   ggplot2::geom_sf(     data = walkability_map,     ggplot2::aes(fill = NatWalkInd),     colour = "white"   ) +   ggrepel::geom_text_repel(     data = walkability_labels,     ggplot2::aes(longitude, latitude, label = GEOID10),     seed = 2026,     min.segment.length = 0,     size = 3   ) +   ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Walkability\nindex") +   ggplot2::coord_sf(     crs = 4326,     default_crs = 4326,     xlim = c(-77, -76.1),     ylim = c(39, 39.7),     expand = FALSE   ) +   ggplot2::labs(     title = "Example Census block groups in Baltimore, Maryland",     subtitle = "EPA National Walkability Index"   ) +   ggplot2::theme_minimal()

text: geoid GEOID10 area interest. 12 character string. NULL, GEOIDs selected (subject filter_geom). can lot data, use caution. geometry block-group polygons returned?  TRUE, result sf object Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), requires sf package.  FALSE (default), tibble attributes. fields Character vector fields return.  NULL (default) returns fields.  See acti_epa_walkability_metadata()$fields. filter_geom Optional spatial filter: sf, sfc, sfg, bbox object (requires sf).  Multiple features unioned.  Inputs CRS transformed WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).  sfg CRS, assumed already longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); passing projected coordinates sfg gives wrong spatial filter. predicate Spatial relationship layer filter_geom: one "intersects", "contains", "crosses", "envelope_intersects", "index_intersects", "overlaps", "touches", "within". n_max Maximum number records return. ... Additional named ArcGIS query parameters passed layer's query endpoint (see ArcGIS REST API "Query (Map Service/Layer)" documentation).

actiwalkability 0.2.0
text: ‘arcgislayers’ longer used. acti_epa_walkability() acti_epa_walkability_metadata() now call EPA ArcGIS REST service directly ‘curl’ ‘jsonlite’. drops sf, terra, s2, units GDAL/GEOS/PROJ system requirements default install. acti_epa_walkability() gains explicit fields, filter_geom, predicate, n_max arguments (previously passed arcgislayers::arc_select()); named arguments ... sent ArcGIS query parameters. Records requested chunks service’s maxRecordCount (1000). Breaking: geometry now defaults FALSE, returning tibble attributes. Previously default TRUE, even geometry = FALSE returned sf object empty geometries. geometry = TRUE returns sf object EPSG:3857 () needs ‘sf’, now Suggests. acti_epa_walkability_metadata() returns plain list (fields data.frame layer url) instead arcgislayers FeatureLayer. GEOIDs containing single quotes escaped clause.
